provisions.use: FIR, Zero FIR (any police station), and information given electronically
Notice to produce documents or electronic communication (investigator’s route to platform data)
Audio-video recording of search and seizure
Admissibility of electronic records; section 63 certificate
Investigation of IT Act offences by an officer of Inspector rank or above

checklist: Carry your original device and a photo ID, and ask for the complaint receipt number.
Ask for a copy of the FIR. If registration is refused or deferred, ask for the reason in writing.
If you used an electronic complaint, sign it at the station within the permitted time.
Do not delete chats, do not pay, and do not reply to the accused.
Keep the evidence bundle and the output of verify.py, and note the date you uploaded the evidence.
